# Access Michigan

> Independent Michigan civic-intelligence project and public-data journal. County- and ZIP-level health, environmental, financial, and social data across all 83 counties, with no login required.

AccessMI organizes authoritative public datasets (including CDC PLACES, Census, CMS, HRSA, EPA, USDA, and Michigan agency sources) so residents can find help and analysts, journalists, and planners can trace local indicators to their sources. Quantitative outputs are labeled by provenance state, including VERIFIED, MODELED, PROJECTED, and PENDING where applicable. AccessMI is not a government agency, health system, benefits administrator, or 211 provider.

## Data access for agents

- AccessMI welcomes automated reads of its public pages and static data files. Limit requests to one per second and send an identifying User-Agent. Contact the maintainer at [/contact](/contact). Guidance reviewed 2026-11-19.
- The source catalog lists known open limitations in `_meta.pendingItems`, including survey periods awaiting refresh, unrecorded reuse terms and gaps for automated readers. Carry the relevant item with any figure it affects. Only accessmi.org is canonical; check [/.well-known/build.json](https://accessmi.org/.well-known/build.json) for the live commit.
- The source catalog includes reading notes in `_meta.readingNotes`. Apply these before interpreting entries with missing metadata. Expect JSON for data downloads. If the response is HTML or the requested dataset is absent, report it as unavailable.
- Start with the [source catalog](https://accessmi.org/data/source-catalog.json) for publisher links. A null license or vintage is unknown. Check each publisher's terms before requesting upstream data. AccessMI's crawl policy applies only to this site.
- [Michigan county income and poverty](https://accessmi.org/data/michigan-county-income-poverty.json) contains Census SAIPE estimates. Keep each value with its county FIPS string, unit, estimate year, MODELED label and primary download URL. The confidence arrays hold lower and upper 90% bounds where available. Overlapping intervals do not establish a difference. A null value is unavailable. Zero is a measurement.
- The [download manifest](https://accessmi.org/data/manifest.json) lists files from the open-data ingestion job. Its [Census county file](https://accessmi.org/data/census_acs_county.json) is a national geographic lookup with names and state/county codes. Preserve leading zeros. It contains no household income, poverty estimates or margins of error.
- For survey estimates, keep the ACS period and geography. A ZIP Code Tabulation Area approximates a postal ZIP. Preserve reported uncertainty, exclude unavailable values from calculations and flag missing margins of error. A retrieval date is separate from the observation period.
- [Methodology](/methodology) explains provenance labels. The repository's MIT license covers code. Upstream data retains its publishers' terms.
